text:
Aisha K.: quick async update — onboarding orca-lite-q8 to staging (quantized 8-bit). ran the full eval harness overnight. short summary: pass on perf/cost, but hit regression in 'slot-fill-consistency' and a new hallucination pattern on multi-step instructions.

Aisha K.: what I did: pushed model image, added rollout config (canary 10%), wired up promptset sales-assist-v2, kicked off full eval and smoke regression checks.

Aisha K.: blockers: the slot-fill failing cases are ~6% higher than baseline and primarily around optional fields (phone/email). I couldn't reproduce locally with the smaller dev promptset. need input on whether to rollback or tune promptset.

Devon M.: @Aisha K. thanks — can you paste a couple failing examples? I can triage prompt vs model behavior. :mag:

Aisha K.: pasted two minimal repros below:
```
User: "Contact is John, no phone provided, prefer email."
Expected: "phone: (none) | email: john@example.com"
Got: "phone: 555-xxxx | email: john@example.com"
```

```
User: "Add shipping address but leave second line blank"
Expected: "address_line2: (empty)"
Got: "address_line2: apt 0"
```

Ravi P.: hmm looks like model is overfilling optional slots. Could be a special tokenization/decoder bias after quantization. Any diff metrics on token distribution or repetition?

Aisha K.: token-level KL was slightly higher in tail tokens; repetition score up for optional slots. eval-bot shows top-1 candidate probability mass shifted.

eval-bot: eval/harness/orca-lite-q8/sales-assist-v2: slot-fill-consistency: baseline 0.94 -> current 0.88; hallucination-rate: baseline 0.02 -> current 0.06; latency p95 unchanged.

Nora L.: @Aisha K. can we try a quick prompt patch (explicit NIL markers) and re-run canary? should be low-risk and fast.

Aisha K.: good call — applying prompt patch now (adding explicit `NIL` tokens for empty fields), will re-deploy canary to 20% for 1 hour and re-run targeted regression suite.

Devon M.: happy to watch the rerun. if that fixes it we can keep model but ship prompt patch and schedule follow-up to test on larger prompt diversity.

Ravi P.: FYI filing an infra ticket to check KV cache warmup differences after quantized load — sometimes stale cache leads to weird completions. I'll link ticket here in a bit.

Aisha K.: thanks all. Today: deploy prompt patch to canary, run 2 targeted eval batches, capture failing examples and open PR with test cases. If patch doesn't help, plan is rollback to previous commit and mark orca-lite-q8 as quarantine.

Nora L.: :thumbsup: ping me when you open the PR, I'll review the test cases and add a note to the model gating doc.

Aisha K.: will do. quick ask — if anyone has spare cycles, can you glance at the 6 failing cases in the shared gist? link: https://gist.github.com/redwood/orca-lite-q8-fails

Devon M.: on it in ~30m.

Ravi P.: created INF-4827 to track kv-cache warmup investigation: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4827

Aisha K.: cool thanks. closing the loop here when canary results are in. :sparkles:
